additional_context: OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current issue-type CodeSystem source is source/operationoutcome/codesystem-issue-type.xml. Current source contains the requested wording and no remaining OperationOutcome source instance of "receiving the error". Jira searches found no later related issue beyond FHIR-18525, and focused Zulip/Confluence searches found no issue-specific or conflicting community record.
